# USR-006: Login accounts are used

- **Group:** Users and privilege
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Login capable accounts that have not been seen for 90 days (or never) are credentials nobody watches. They keep working for whoever holds the password or key.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo lastlog
```

## How to fix it

Lock unused accounts with `passwd -l <user>` or remove them.

Run `stackward explain USR-006` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
